_help: Numbers added by hand to the /stats page. audience: e.g. {"label": "Instagram followers", "value": 1200, "url": "https://www.instagram.com/..."}, shown as they are. countingSince: the day the site's own counting began (shown on the page). before.months: counts of a month from before the counter started again (visitors, views, app, downloads, countries {"PT": 47}; see addCountsBefore in scripts/stats-collector.mjs), added to the server's counts of that month. The collector reads this file every hour.
